subject: general
question: The sculpture of bearded man, found in Mohejo-daro, is made of which material?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Stone**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sculpture of the **Bearded Man**, found in **Mohenjo-Daro**, is a significant artifact of the **Indus Valley Civilization**.
 
• This sculpture is made of **stone**, specifically **steatite **
 
• **The Bearded Man is considered one of the finest examples of ancient craftsmanship** and reflects the **artistic skills** of the people of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• **The sculpture is believed to represent a priest or a nobleman, showcasing a well-defined beard and a robe with detailed patterns.**
 
• **The use of stone** indicates the advanced techniques employed by the civilization for carving and sculpting.
 
• **Its discovery in Mohenjo-Daro highlights the urban sophistication and cultural richness** of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• **Artifacts like the Bearded Man provide crucial insights into the social, cultural, and artistic aspects** of one of the world's oldest civilizations.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Terracotta**__ 

 __
 
• **Terracotta** is a type of earthenware made from baked clay.
 
• **It was widely used by the Indus Valley Civilization to create figurines, pottery, and seals.**
 
• **Terracotta items are significant for understanding the daily life, religious beliefs, and art** of ancient civilizations.
 
 ** **
 
• **Bronze**__ 
 __
 
• **Bronze** is an alloy of copper and tin and was commonly used by ancient civilizations for making tools, weapons, and sculptures.
 
• **The famous Dancing Girl** of Mohenjo-Daro is made of bronze and represents the advanced metallurgical skills of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
 ** **
 
• **Copper**__ 
 
 
• **Copper** was extensively used in the Indus Valley Civilization for making utensils, tools, and ornaments.
 
• **The use of copper indicates the civilization's knowledge of metallurgy** and trade networks.
 
 ** **
